11.by: Claude, play.html benchmark() in the Claude desktop browser pane on an Apple M3 laptop (integrated GPU), not a human-observed frame counter
11.note: Re-measured for N2 (new alien bodies, ~41k triangles in view, up from ~21k). District 10 HARD, 4 aliens, camera turning a full circle, 1920x1080 at pixel ratio 1, GPU forced to finish every frame. Medium, three runs: mean 4.2-4.5 ms, p95 5.2-7.5 ms, 50 draw calls. Build 8 measured 10.9-12.2 ms mean on the same machine with the same recipe; fewer bolts since N1 explain some of the draw-call drop, and the rest is not attributed -- both runs are within budget, which is the claim. Phones: not measured.
